Class TagBuffer<T>

java.lang.Object
com.saicone.nbt.nio.TagBuffer<T>
Type Parameters:
T - the tag object implementation.
Direct Known Subclasses:
NetworkTagBuffer
public class TagBuffer<T> extends Object
Tag Buffer
A tag buffer is a full implementation of NBT format using Java NIO API by providing methods to get/put tag objects from/to a delegated ByteBuffer.
